title: Operations Analyst
org_line: Riverbend Foods | sector food distribution | size 200 to 500 | ownership private
description: Riverbend Foods is looking for an Operations Analyst to own weekly reporting for our 6 distribution centers. Familiarity with Stockline warehouse software is a plus. We offer a hybrid schedule and a team of 8.

title: Reporting Lead
org_line: Calder Health Partners | sector outpatient care | size 50 to 200 | ownership nonprofit
description: Calder Health Partners is seeking a Reporting Lead to build and maintain dashboards for 20 clinics. The team meets every Tuesday.

title: Process Improvement Coordinator
org_line: Tallgrass Logistics | sector freight | size 500 to 1000 | ownership private
description: Tallgrass Logistics needs a Process Improvement Coordinator to find waste in our dock and billing workflows. You will measure cycle times, interview supervisors in 4 regional hubs, and propose changes with a clear before and after. Experience shortening a close or billing cycle is valued. Travel up to 15 percent.
